page.title: Check charts in CI
page.description: Fail a pull request whose chart does not compile, cannot work as written, is not in the canonical layout, or breaks the actors running the deployed version.

hero.headline: Stop broken charts before they deploy
hero.lede: Four commands fail a pull request with exit status 1. The last, diff, compares the change with the version your actors run now.

section.heading: 1. Add the command to mise.toml
section.p: mise installs the release on each runner and checks it against the release's checksums. Name a version in place of latest to pin it.

section.heading: 2. Keep the image you deploy
section.p: Compile the chart when you deploy it and store deployed.tai where the next build can fetch it. The deployed chart here is the tutorial's order.

section.heading: 3. Check, lint and format the change
section.p: The pull request renames paying to charging. check -W treats a warning as an error, and the renamed chart compiles with neither.
With --deny all, any finding of lint exits with 1, such as an unreachable state. The renamed chart has none.
Charts in one layout keep a pull request's diff to its real edits. fmt --check fails on a file out of layout and changes nothing; fmt -w rewrites it.

section.heading: 4. Compare the change with the deployed image
section.p: The change passes every check, yet orders waiting in paying would lose their state. diff --breaking --exit-code lists the changes that break them and exits with 1.

example.caption: It exits with status 1: a migration would put each order waiting in paying back in open, its charge already sent.

claim.statement: A removed state sends actors to an ancestor
claim.p: An actor in a removed state enters its nearest kept ancestor's initial state, and no entry action runs.

section.p: Keep the state's id, or deploy the new version without migrating, so running orders finish on the old one.

section.heading: 5. Run the checks on every pull request
section.p: This GitHub Actions job installs mise's tools with mise-action and runs the four commands. Fetch deployed.tai from wherever your deploy stores it.
section.code: name: charts on: pull_request jobs: charts: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: jdx/mise-action@v2 - run: tinyactors check -W order.scxml - run: tinyactors lint --deny all order.scxml - run: tinyactors fmt --check order.scxml - run: tinyactors diff --breaking --exit-code deployed.tai order.scxml

claim.statement: Exit status 1 means a check failed
claim.p: Status 2 is a command line not understood, and 3 a file that could not be read.
